title: Proper algebraic-space direct image preserves bounded-below coherent cohomology
statement: Let $Y$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning that $Y$ is quasi-compact and has an affine open cover with Noetherian coordinate rings [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $X$ be an algebraic space over $Y$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] and $f:X\to Y$ its proper structure morphism. Proper means that its diagonal is a closed immersion, that it is quasi-compact and locally of finite type on etale scheme charts [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and that every algebraic-space base change is closed on underlying topological spaces. Work with module sheaves on the small etale sites of $X$ and $Y$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Locally Noetherian for an algebraic space means that an etale scheme atlas is locally Noetherian. Coherent means that on each Noetherian affine etale chart $\operatorname{Spec}R$ a module sheaf is associated to a finitely generated $R$-module $N$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], with value $B\otimes_RN$ on affine etale charts $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$. Let $G\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ have coherent cohomology vanishing in all sufficiently negative degrees. Write $Rf_*$ for the total right derived functor [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] of module direct image under the induced morphism of ringed small-etale topoi [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]; it is computed by K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Then $Rf_*G\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ has coherent cohomology vanishing in all sufficiently negative degrees.

source.place: Tag 0D0R (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), specialized with the base scheme S=Y and a proper morphism f; coherence convention: spaces-cohomology.tex Tag 07UB (lemma-coherent-Noetherian).

proof.text: Choose $a\in\mathbf Z$ with $H^q(G)=0$ for $q<a$. The standard derived-category description gives a representative complex $K^\bullet$ with $K^q=0$ for $q<a$. Module sheaves on both small etale ringed sites are Grothendieck abelian. The module adjunction makes $f_*$ a right adjoint, hence it preserves finite limits and is left exact; it is additive since its action on module maps preserves their sums. Thus the bounded-below hypercohomology theorem applies to $v=f_*$ and $K^\bullet$.

source.place: Tag 0D0R (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), first proof sentence: same proof as Tag 08GK (lemma-direct-image-coherent); derived.tex Tag 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor).

proof.text: Apply the truncation spectral sequence to obtain $E_2^{p,q}=R^pf_*H^q(G)\Rightarrow H^{p+q}(Rf_*G)$. It vanishes unless $p\geq0$ and $q\geq a$, stabilizes at each bidegree, and gives a finite filtration of every $H^n(Rf_*G)$ with graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,n-p}$. Its derived functor is the one in the statement: both compute module direct image on K-injective resolutions, so the canonical comparison of total right derived functors identifies their values.

source.place: Tag 0D0R (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), first proof sentence: same proof as Tag 08GK (lemma-direct-image-coherent); derived.tex Tag 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor).

proof.text: For every $p\geq0$ and $q$, apply coherent higher direct image to the coherent module $H^q(G)$. Here $Y$ is regarded as an algebraic space over $S=Y$ through its representable sheaf $h_Y$, whose small etale site consists of the etale $Y$-schemes and whose identity is an etale scheme atlas [def-trf-scheme-algebraic-space]; $f:X\to h_Y$ is the structure map. The morphism is proper by hypothesis and $Y$ is Noetherian, hence locally Noetherian, and so are its etale scheme charts [pqf-def-locnoeth]. It follows that every $E_2^{p,q}$ is coherent. The terms with $p<0$ are zero.

source.place: Tag 0D0R (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), first proof sentence: same proof as Tag 08GK (lemma-direct-image-coherent); derived.tex Tag 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor).

proof.text: On the locally Noetherian scheme $Y$, regarded as the algebraic space $h_Y$ over $S=Y$ on its small etale site [def-trf-scheme-algebraic-space], zero modules, kernels and cokernels of maps between coherent modules, and extensions of coherent modules are coherent. Inductively every $E_r^{p,q}$ is coherent: its next-page term is the cokernel of the induced map from the image of the incoming differential to the kernel of the outgoing differential, and each image is the kernel of the corresponding cokernel. Pointwise stabilization makes $E_\infty^{p,q}$ coherent. For any $n\geq a$, start with the zero end of the finite filtration of $H^n(Rf_*G)$ and use its short exact sequences with these coherent graded pieces. Induction on its finite length proves $H^n(Rf_*G)$ coherent.

source.place: Tag 0D0R (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), first proof sentence: same proof as Tag 08GK (lemma-direct-image-coherent); derived.tex Tag 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor).

proof.text: If $n<a$, there is no pair $p\geq0$, $q\geq a$ with $p+q=n$. All graded pieces in the finite exhaustive separated filtration of $H^n(Rf_*G)$ are therefore zero, so $H^n(Rf_*G)=0$. Zero modules are coherent as well. Together with the preceding step this gives coherent cohomology and the same lower bound $a$ for $Rf_*G$.
